title: Cleaning up a feature branch
diff:
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease origin feature/search

concepts.description: Rebasing replays commits onto a new base, creating new commits with new hashes, so anyone who already pulled the old ones diverges.
concepts.context: rebases a branch that has already been pushed

concepts.description: A lease refuses the push if the remote branch moved since you last fetched, unlike a plain force push that overwrites it.
